title: General Information｜国宝　大浦天主堂　公式サイト

facts.fact: Church interior photography is prohibited; exterior shots are allowed, subject to paying admission before taking photos within the premises.
facts.excerpt: Taking photographs inside the church is prohibited, but exterior shots are allowed.

facts.fact: The admission fee includes the museum fee; the entrance staircase is long and wheelchair users need assistance.
facts.excerpt: The admission fee includes the museum fee.

facts.fact: The church entrance is only reached by a long staircase; handrails do not make this a step-free route.
facts.excerpt: there is no other way to enter the cathedral other than stairs

facts.fact: The operator distinguishes March–October and November–February closing times; church events may cause closure, so the tourism directory's generic18:00 should not be used as a universal time.
